name: zinput_di_is_joystick_device_ready
description: zInput::DI_IsJoystickDeviceReady returns true only when the joystick initialized flag equals one.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4722b0 compares g_zInput_JoystickInitialized to exactly one, sets al from equality, and returns the zero-extended boolean.
Native smoke zinput_joystick_ref_and_enable_smoke verifies the zero flag and non-one flag return false, then verifies initialized value one returns true before the joystick ref-count workflow.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x4722b0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput joystick status pass.
